title: Fetch WavPack correction data only when exact output is required

definition.title: Fetch WavPack correction data only when exact output is required
definition.source_excerpt: Using installed libwavpack 5.8.1, an 8-second stereo source was encoded in hybrid mode into a 282,458-byte lossy .wv base and 123,890-byte .wvc correction file. Base-only output is close but intentionally not exact (S16 RMSE 0.983). Base + correction is sample-exact. At the 192,000-frame / 4-second block boundary, the earlier correction blocks were removed entirely. A file containing only the correction blocks at and after that boundary still decoded the suffix sample-for-sample exactly, deferring 61,782 correction bytes. Exact mode therefore has a real block-boundary admission rule; it must never silently claim lossless output when correction data is absent.
